text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I drop by the dance studio to pick up
some stuff I
forgot, only to find it
occupied.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh... This choreography is pretty tough. There's nothing special about it, but it's still tricky...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Trainer. Didn't realize you were
there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature is practicing hard, but I
notice
something about the
choreography...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
This? Yeah... I have a feeling I'll be
dancing these
parts a lot.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So doesn't it make sense to focus on
them when
practicing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her defeatist attitude towards her own
potential
takes me aback, and I'm left
struggling for words.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh... I was expecting you to tell me to
practice
for the center spot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature knows what works for her
best. I'd
rather respect how she feels
than rush her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I don't want to deny her potential
either.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You and your silver tongue...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All right, all right. Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's not necessary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her tone says she's annoyed, but her
expression
softens a little.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Center spot, huh? I figured you would
say that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has the potential to come in first
place, but
most importantly, I don't want
her to give up from
the get-go.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah, right...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All right, all right. If you say so.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how good my dancing will
be,
considering how late I'm starting.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But hey, if you believe in me, then
maybe...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Nothiiing!
